name: Regular Council Meeting
agenda_text:
City of El Segundo Video Streaming
MEETING SUMMARY
c) Presentation – Finance award – Government Finance Officers Association's (GOFA) award.
b) Presentation – Chief Whalen, introduction of a new Police Officer
d) Presentation - Christopher Hentzen, Park Maintenance Superintendent
e) Commendation - All volunteers, sponsors and supporters of the 2017 Community Christmas Dinner at the Joslyn Center
f) Presentation – West Basin Municipal Water District – Grant for Water Bottle Filling Station.
Public Communications
17. City Council receive and file a presentation on the City's customer satisfaction survey.
Recess
1. Review and approve the three-year strategic plan (FY 2018 through 2021).
2. Adopt Resolutions necessary to place the sales tax ballot measure on the April 10, 2018 election.
3. Receive and file an update on the progress of the Downtown Committee.
4. Council to report out of closed session and take action on a possible amendment to the City Attorney's (Hensley Law Group's) contract.
5. Direct staff to open the recruitment process for the positions on the Committees, Commissions and Boards ("CCBs") that expires in the year 2018.
13. Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with Vision Technology.
14. Authorize the City Manager to conduct a fresh start "refinance" of the City's unfunded pension liability (UAL) with California Public Employees Retirement System (CalPERS).
Reports
18. Direct staff whether the 2022 General Municipal Election and subsequent City elections should be held in either March or November.
19. Approve request by Mr. S. Claus for a waiver of the permits required for doing business within the City of El Segundo.
